amendment_rule: Never overwrite history. Store every accession and let an amendment affect only decisions strictly after its later acceptance time.
availability_rule: Use EDGAR acceptanceDateTime joined by accession number; if absent, conservatively use 23:59:59 UTC on filingDate.
